selection: Use first557fixture only, not sweep. Main6holds=.48s: 12 control variables accommodate world pose plus roughly9 independent mechanical endpoint conditions; selected BEFORE science, not a post-failure extension. Follow2holds=.16s independently gated but included in same design. Targets are original seed arc s0+v0*T and its segment tangent/curvature. No retargeting or duration change.
variables: 8holds x steer/signed pedal (16), plus endpoint periodic v,beta,delta,gas,omega4 (8). Total24. Periodic v[5,v0]; same beta/joint/gas/omega bounds as557. Signed pedal positive gas/negative brake.
